ns2:section.sectionText: This is an introductory course for freshman and transfer students who are new to the University of Illinois. Students will discover what Illinois’ top actuarial program has to offer and how to navigate their time on campus as well as their time post-graduation. This course also teaches students useful professional skills such as resume building, interview prep, and recruiting strategies. It also offers students career advice and discusses the different paths to becoming an actuary.
